description.en: Friendly static Beelzebufo-inspired teaching frog, broad thick flanged head, low stout body and folded grounded limbs. Soft tissue, color, scale and pose are artistic; no toxicity, feeding or jumping mechanism claim.
description.zh: 友善静态Beelzebufo启发教学蛙，宽厚侧扩头部、矮壮躯干与接地折叠四肢。软组织、颜色、尺度及姿态属美术选择，不声称毒性、捕食或跳跃机制。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
